Problem Description
: Outlet OoO
We have analysed the logs & the outlets are out of order due to Error Polling Coap, which means the internal communication with SECC was lost for a brief period of time. Our charger will reconnect to SECC within 5 seconds. While SECC is not reachable, an 'Outlet Out of Order' flag will be active and will be cleared once the charger reconnects to SECC. We reviewed the charger just now and we didn't see any issues in it, all the outlet are healthy & available for charging.
I hope there are no further queries related to this. If not, shall we proceed with closing this ticket?
For future reference, your case number is
0417995
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma
